name: chart-history
description: Configuration keywords for 'plot item create chart-history'. Draws a line chart of one or more recorded histories. Unlike geometry items, a chart-history has no automatic data: you must bind each trace with the 'history <name>' keyword, or the chart renders empty.
critical_note: The 'history <name>' argument is the history NAME (the Name column shown by 'history list'), NOT its numeric ID. A chart-history created with no 'history' keyword, or with an ID / a name that no history has, produces an empty chart (axes only, garbage auto-scale) and raises NO error. This is the most common cause of 'plot history draws nothing'.

basic_keywords.description: Bind a history trace to the chart by its Name. Repeat the keyword to overlay multiple traces on one chart.
Cross-plot the bound history against another history (x = the 'vs' history) instead of the default 'vs step'. Applies to the trace it follows.
Show or hide the chart item without deleting it (default on when created)
Trace draw style: line (default), or point / line-point variants
Per-axis scaling. 'log on|off' toggles log scale; 'minimum <v>|auto' and 'maximum <v>|auto' set fixed or automatic limits.
basic_keywords.syntax: axis-y log on minimum auto maximum auto

basic_keywords.description: Reverse the direction of a trace's x or y axis (default off)
Restrict the sampled range of a trace: first step, last step, and stride (0 = full range / no skip)
Show or hide the trace legend (on by default)

common_usage_patterns.use_case: Plot a single history vs step
common_usage_patterns.command:
plot create 'hist'
plot 'hist' current
plot 'hist' item create chart-history history 'ratio'
common_usage_patterns.description: Chart the history named 'ratio'. Confirm the name first with 'history list' (Name column, not ID).

common_usage_patterns.use_case: Overlay multiple histories on one chart
common_usage_patterns.command: plot item create chart-history history 'ke' history 'ratio' history 'unbal'
common_usage_patterns.description: Repeat 'history <name>' for each trace; all share the same axes

common_usage_patterns.command: plot item create chart-history history 'axial-stress' vs 'axial-strain'
common_usage_patterns.description: Stress-strain style x-y curve instead of vs step

common_usage_patterns.use_case: Export the chart to an image
common_usage_patterns.description: Render the current chart to PNG (works headless via the bridge)

troubleshooting.symptom: Chart is empty / no curve, axes show a huge exponent like 10^301
troubleshooting.cause: No valid trace bound. Usually 'history <id>' was passed a numeric ID, or the name is misspelled, or the 'history' keyword was omitted entirely.
troubleshooting.fix: Run 'history list', copy the exact string from the Name column, and pass it: plot item create chart-history history '<Name>'

troubleshooting.cause: The history was created but the model has not cycled since, so only the initial sample exists.
troubleshooting.fix: Cycle the model (model cycle / model solve) after creating the history so it accumulates samples.

notes: chart-history is engine-agnostic: the same keywords apply in FLAC and 3DEC.
These keywords are not officially documented by Itasca; they were verified empirically and via 'plot export datafile'.
Use 'plot <name> export datafile filename <f>' to dump the exact keyword state of an existing chart built in the GUI.
